$schema: declared frame-coverage ledger — read by scripts/frame-coverage.mjs (issue #163)
readme: Per-component declaration of which contract axes (FRAME-COVERAGE-STANDARD.md) a frame COVERS.
A dimension is UNTESTED unless declared here as "covered" or "N/A:<reason>".
Component agents authoring frame content add their component under `components` as cases land.
Only an executed/authored case may be marked "covered" — never infer from a happy-path render.

infra.note: Global harness capabilities this branch provides for EVERY /frame/** route — they make a dimension EXERCISABLE, but a per-component `covered` mark still requires an authored case that demonstrates it.
infra.rtl: ?dir=rtl on any /frame/<id> flips logical CSS for the whole subtree
infra.accessibilityAxe: scripts/check-frame-axe.mjs (check:frame-axe) — desktop + mobile-sm axe per frame
